timing_diagnostics.recommendation: Recapture equal-length sequences over independently verified matching windows; do not truncate or stretch their signatures to infer timing. These inputs contain no timestamps. Independently verify cadence, duration and interaction alignment using source timestamps before judging temporal fidelity.

critique_rubric: Motion comparison (both animate; motion energy ratio 0.10). `motion_status` is compared. A null `motion_score` is inconclusive (static or capture_unreliable), not a perfect 100. `motion_energy_score` aliases `motion_score` and measures energy similarity only, not animation fidelity. Read timing_diagnostics status, reason and recommendation: without timestamps timing is inconclusive and cadence is not verified. sampled_profile and its temporal_corr alias are optional frame-index correlation, not rhythm or elapsed-time alignment. The motion_signature chart (green=reference, blue=candidate) shows sampled intensity against frame index, not guaranteed capture cadence. A one-shot animation may have finished before capture. Confirm capture state before attributing a low energy score to the product.
